name: The First Troll Legend
summary: At Bal’lal Ruins, the First Troll Legend is carved on a tablet called Moon Over the Vale. Brother Nimetz seeks its markings as part of his study of Colonel Kurzen’s fall.

sections.title: Moon Over the Vale
sections.body: Among the stones of Bal’lal Ruins, the tablet called Moon Over the Vale bears the First Troll Legend. Brother Nimetz at Rebel Camp asks you to transcribe its markings. He hopes the legends may explain what has corrupted Colonel Kurzen, once a noble man.

faq.q: Where is the First Troll Legend?
faq.answer: The First Troll Legend is on the Moon Over the Vale tablet in the Bal’lal Ruins of Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: What is Moon Over the Vale?
faq.answer: Moon Over the Vale is the tablet in Bal’lal Ruins that bears the First Troll Legend.
Brother Nimetz at Rebel Camp asks you to transcribe the troll legends.

faq.q: Why is Brother Nimetz studying troll legends?
faq.answer: Brother Nimetz hopes the troll legends will reveal what caused Colonel Kurzen’s fall into depravity.
Brother Nimetz seeks four legends from tablets in Stranglethorn Vale. The first is in Bal’lal Ruins; the second is in Vile Reef, and the third and fourth are in Zul’Kunda.

angles.text: Brother Nimetz’s search concerns Colonel Kurzen, an Alliance officer whose fall troubles those at Rebel Camp.
